mapper.select:
select mf.*, u.name as memberName, u.phone, coalesce(d.name, s.name) as goodsName, coalesce(d.image, s.image) as goodsImage from member_favorite mf left join user u on mf.user_id = u.id left join dish d on mf.dish_id = d.id left join setmeal s on mf.setmeal_id = s.id
and u.name like concat('%', #{memberName}, '%')
and coalesce(d.name, s.name) like concat('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
order by mf.create_time desc
